scope: First working bring-up of DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 on the ds4 production-lineage weights. This is NOT a requalification pass: golden, token-parity, accuracy, soak, and the agent gate have not been run, and the speed suite reported suite_valid=false for the reason recorded under harness_gap below.

weights.verification_note: All three files independently re-hashed on 2026-08-09 and matched the HF-published sha256 in the pin. The base and dspark_support downloads were verified once by the fetch and once again before launch.

engine.byte_identity_note: Rebuild differs from the committed production binary hash because -g -lineinfo embeds absolute source paths and this build lives at a different path. Source provenance is exact. Fixable with -ffile-prefix-map; same defect class as the llama-server reproducibility failure in results/dsv4-cold-load.

dspark.error: ds4: required tensor is missing: dspark.main_proj.weight
dspark.analysis: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-support-0731.gguf is not a DSpark drafter. gguf-tools/README.md documents --dspark-support as producing 'the support GGUF used by ds4 --mtp', holding packed mtp.* tensors plus dspark.* metadata keys. DS4_DSPARK_MODEL instead requires a drafter carrying dspark.main_proj.weight. The in-tree converter (gguf-tools/deepseek4-quantize.c) exposes --dspark-manifest and --dspark-support only; it has no mode that emits a dspark.main_proj.weight drafter. The pre-0731 production drafter came from the third-party bleysg repo, which publishes no 0731 successor, and a drafter must remain token-distribution-compatible with its base. There is therefore no available 0731 DSpark drafter.

mtp.note: max_seq reduced from 32 to 15 by the engine's batch-fit logic to fit memory; free=15.86 GiB headroom=8.00 GiB at fit time.

smoke.prompt: Explain in one sentence why the sky is blue.
smoke.note: Speculative decoding is active and effective through MTP alone, without any DSpark drafter.

ctx_4096.median_note: Harness returned null because every rep in this cell was marked invalid; the raw per-rep decode rates above are still recorded.

speed.interpretation: At ctx=0 the 0731 mtp profile measures faster than the v0.4.2 dspark profile on every rep (all five above the 19.15 baseline median), with TTFT and prefill unchanged. At ctx=4096 it is at or slightly below the 20.47 baseline. Because the comparison crosses BOTH a weights change and a profile change (dspark -> mtp), it does not isolate the effect of 0731 itself and must not be quoted as a qualification result.

harness_gap.observed: suite_valid=false. ctx=0 had 1 of 5 reps invalid ('timestamp/client token mismatch: events=255, client=254'); ctx=4096 had 5 of 5 invalid ('events=255, client=256').
harness_gap.analysis: Every rep produced sane timings and 255-256 tokens, so this is a counting disagreement inside the harness, not an engine or model failure. Rep records carry non-empty generated_reasoning_sha256/generated_reasoning_bytes alongside generated_content_*, and the smoke completion emitted explicit numbered reasoning steps. The 0731 release adds selectable reasoning effort levels, so the model interleaves reasoning tokens that scripts/30_bench_speed.py, written for the pre-0731 model, does not reconcile against its client-side content-token count.
harness_gap.consequence: scripts/30_bench_speed.py must be taught to account for reasoning tokens before any 0731 speed result can be declared valid. The same question applies to 31_bench_accuracy.py, 32_golden_tests.py, and 33_token_parity.py, none of which have been run against 0731.

safety.lock_note: The engine defaults to /tmp/ds4.lock, which is owned by the production dsv4 user (mode 0600); the first launch attempt failed closed there. DS4_LOCK_FILE now points at a caller-owned path so a pre-cutover run can never contend with production.

remaining_before_cutover: Fix DSV4-0731-H1 and re-run the speed suite to a valid result.
Run golden, token-parity, accuracy (gsm8k/mmlu/humaneval dev+holdout), soak, and the agent gate against 0731.

Decide the drafter question: accept the mtp profile as the 0731 production profile, or produce a first-party DSpark drafter from the HF DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark checkpoint. The latter would also retire audit finding HIGH-2 in docs/ds4-security-review.md, which flagged the third-party bleysg drafter for having no provenance chain.
Re-run the matched llama.cpp comparison arm on the staged unsloth UD-Q2_K_XL 0731 set.
Owner cutover per scripts/97_dsv4_0731_cutover.md, including API-key re-keying.
